sanskrit_verse:
न भुङ्क्ते यः स्वम् आधानं नादद्यान् न निवेदयेत् ।
प्रमीतसाक्षी ऋणिकः तस्य लेख्यम् अपार्थकम् ॥
transliteration: na bhuṅkte yaḥ svam ādhānaṃ nādadyān na nivedayet / pramītasākṣī ṛṇikaḥ tasya lekhyam apārthakam //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who neither consumes his own deposit nor returns it nor reports it, while being a witness to its existence, renders all written evidence related to him void.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is established through conscious acknowledgment of possession and responsibility.
Causation arises from the failure to act in alignment with witnessed truth.
Capacity-based responsibility requires recognition of one's role as a custodian or witness.
Restoration logic demands reintegration of abandoned or unclaimed resources into lawful circulation.
Consciousness alignment occurs when integrity is restored through transparent action.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity holds a resource AND has witnessed its rightful ownership THEN that entity MUST either return, consume ethically, or declare the resource publicly.
IF an entity fails to acknowledge possession OR neglects declaration THEN all associated recorded claims are nullified automatically.
IF a witness to a deposit does not act within one lunar cycle THEN system shall flag all linked assets for review by Dharma-administrative AI.
ALL written instruments tied to inactive custodians SHALL be suspended until completion process is executed.
RESTORATION is triggered upon voluntary re-declaration of custody and initiation of alignment protocol.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any party found to have willfully neglected acknowledgment of custodial holdings—especially where third-party rights are implicated—shall face automatic suspension of all documentary evidentiary weight. The court must initiate restorative proceedings to reintegrate such assets lawfully rather than impose punitive sanctions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the root error as omission of dharmic witnessing. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how neglecting to report leads to systemic distortion. Responsibility aligns proportionally to awareness retained. Non-punitive reality asserts that disconnection from integrity naturally nullifies legal instrument efficacy.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Individual must publicly reaffirm custodial status and complete asset transfer or consumption within seven days.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Entity undergoes guided self-assessment under AI supervision to restore clarity of intent.
Integrity Reintegration Cycle: All dormant assets linked to individual are audited and realigned with lawful circulation.
Witness Restoration Module: Consciousness recalibration through affirmation practices to prevent future omissions.
Dharma Ledger Reset: Nullified documents are archived; new declarations must pass integrity validation before re-entry.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
